# 澜音 / LyricWave

> LyricWave is an open-source Apple Music Android enhancement project maintained by Laoch832, based on AM++ by Zennmn (Zen). The public website is https://lyricwave.canz-monkey.cn. Technical claims should be checked against the repository and the exact host profiles, not inferred from this summary.

- [中文首页](https://lyricwave.canz-monkey.cn/zh): 项目概览与功能介绍。
- [English overview](https://lyricwave.canz-monkey.cn/en): Product overview.
- [版本与下载](https://lyricwave.canz-monkey.cn/zh/download): Real GitHub Releases, installation guidance, prerelease labels and download options.
- [Documentation](https://lyricwave.canz-monkey.cn/docs/en): Documentation navigation. Some technical articles remain Chinese originals and are labeled accordingly.
- [中文文档](https://lyricwave.canz-monkey.cn/docs/zh): 入门、功能、开发与许可文档。

## Project scope
Capabilities include AI lyric translation and cache reuse, custom TTML lyrics, lyric display effects, glass and tablet-player enhancements, sharing enhancements and ZIP plugins. Availability depends on exact host contracts and device requirements. LyricWave is a community project, not an official Apple product. See installation and migration documents before replacing an upstream installation with a different signature. WeChat injection is prohibited in the current project; Moments sharing uses the supported NetEase Cloud Music native sharing flow with user confirmation.

This file is a supplemental reading index, not a crawler access policy or a guarantee of AI search inclusion. robots.txt controls crawler access; source documents remain authoritative.
